title: maDMP project
description: One project at one version (definitions/projects/<id>/<version>.yaml, the directory must be the declared id and the filename the declared version). Strict: every field required, none extra. Its metadata, then the rules it is built from.

id.description: The project's machine name, declared once, and the name of the directory this file sits in. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

organizationId.description: The organization the project belongs to. Lowercase letters and digits, in parts joined by single dots.

name.description: What a reader sees. Free-form, it is never derived from `id`.

version.description: The project's version, X.Y.Z. Must equal the file's own name: definitions/projects/<id>/<version>.yaml.

author.description: Who develops the project. Markdown, a link included.

license.description: The licence of the project, as a reader sees it, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0'.

rules.description: The rules the project is built from, each pinned at one version: [{standard: version}, ...] -> definitions/rules/<standard>/<version>.json, in the order written. One key per entry, the standard in snake_case and the version X.Y.Z, quoted (unquoted 1.0 would be a YAML float, not a version).
